items.title: 首张月球银版照片
items.creator: John W. Draper
items.note: 摄影术诞生仅一年后即拍下月球表面细节，天文摄影的开端。
items.noteEn: Lunar surface detail captured just a year after photography's invention — the dawn of astrophotography.

items.title: 莎拉·伯恩哈特
items.creator: Nadar
items.note: 19世纪名流的「肖像圣殿」，作者本人还是乘气球航拍巴黎的第一人。
items.noteEn: A 19th-century temple of celebrity portraits, by a photographer-aeronaut who also made Paris's first aerial shots.

items.title: 阿尔弗雷德·丁尼生
items.creator: Julia Margaret Cameron
items.note: 柔焦湿板里的桂冠诗人，摄影争取艺术身份的早期证明。
items.noteEn: A soft-focus wet-plate poet laureate—photography claiming its place as art.

items.title: 约塞米蒂河谷
items.creator: Carleton Watkins
items.note: 19世纪用巨型湿板相机拍约塞米蒂，直接推动了国家公园的建立。
items.noteEn: Mammoth wet-plate views of Yosemite in the 19th century that helped create the national parks.

items.title: 优胜美地谷
items.creator: Carleton Watkins
items.note: 湿版大画幅第一次让美国西部荒野震撼国会，直接促成优胜美地成为受保护公园。
items.noteEn: Giant wet-plate views of the West so awed Congress they helped make Yosemite a protected park.

items.title: 峡谷地古城遗址
items.en: Ancient Ruins in the Canyon de Chelle
items.creator: Timothy O'Sullivan
items.note: 内战后西部勘探摄影的产物，岩壁与废墟有一种惊人的现代感。
items.noteEn: A product of post-Civil War survey photography—cliffs and ruins startlingly modern in feel.

items.title: 仙女座星系
items.creator: Isaac Roberts
items.note: 首次用长时间曝光揭示仙女座星系的旋涡结构，证明摄影能看见人眼看不到的宇宙。
items.noteEn: Long exposure revealing Andromeda's spiral structure — proof photography sees what the eye cannot.

items.title: 另一半人怎么活
items.creator: Jacob Riis
items.note: 用镁光闪进纽约贫民窟，社会纪实摄影的起点。
items.noteEn: Flash-lit tenements of the New York poor—the dawn of social documentary.

items.title: 平顶大厦
items.creator: Edward Steichen
items.note: 雨雾中湿漉漉的熨斗大厦，画意摄影最著名的浪漫剪影。
items.noteEn: The Flatiron in rain and fog—the most famous romantic silhouette of Pictorialism.

items.title: 熨斗大厦
items.creator: Edward Steichen
items.note: 暮色与雪中的熨斗大厦被拍成印象派式的剪影，早期画意摄影转向现代的一步。
items.noteEn: The Flatiron in dusk and snow as an Impressionist silhouette — pictorialism stepping toward the modern.

items.title: 舵楼
items.creator: Alfred Stieglitz
items.note: 三等舱甲板上的人群被抽象成几何，被视作现代摄影的分水岭。
items.noteEn: Passengers on the steerage deck abstracted into geometry—a watershed of modern photography.

items.title: 老巴黎
items.creator: Eugène Atget
items.note: 赶在现代化前，为旧巴黎的店铺与街巷留下一整座影像档案馆。
items.noteEn: An archive of old Paris storefronts and streets, made before modernisation swept them away.

items.title: 老巴黎
items.creator: Eugène Atget
items.note: 在大拆建前记录中世纪巴黎的街巷与店面，被超现实主义者奉为先知，纪实与艺术在此交汇。
items.noteEn: Documenting medieval Paris before the wrecking ball — adopted by the Surrealists as a prophet of documentary art.

items.title: 华尔街
items.creator: Paul Strand
items.note: 金融区街角穿黑衣的上班族排成抽象剪影，现代主义摄影的序章。
items.noteEn: Black-coated clerks at a Wall Street corner—abstraction before its time.

items.title: 1919年日全食
items.creator: Arthur Eddington (expedition)
items.note: 日食观测中恒星位置的偏移验证了广义相对论，摄影直接参与了物理学革命。
items.noteEn: Starlight bending during totality confirmed general relativity — photography at the heart of a physics revolution.

items.title: 动力车间机械师
items.creator: Lewis Hine
items.note: 童工调查摄影师把工人拍成雕像般的英雄，摄影推动了劳动法。
items.noteEn: The child-labour reformer photographed workers as statuesque heroes—images that helped change labour law.

items.title: 黑与白
items.creator: Man Ray
items.note: 非洲面具与基基的脸并置，超现实主义肖像的经典。
items.noteEn: An African mask beside Kiki's face—a classic surrealist portrait.

items.title: 银河选区星图
items.en: Atlas of Selected Regions of the Milky Way
items.creator: E. E. Barnard
items.note: 几十年巡天的摄影星图集，首次系统展示银河暗星云的结构，天文学里程碑。
items.noteEn: Decades of sky photography that first charted the Milky Way's dark nebulae — a milestone of astronomy.

items.title: 鹦鹉螺
items.creator: Edward Weston
items.note: 一颗螺壳被拍成螺旋的完美几何，现代主义把「直接摄影」推向造型的极致。
items.noteEn: A single shell distilled into perfect spiral geometry — modernist "straight photography" at its sculptural peak.

items.title: 自然的艺术形态
items.creator: Karl Blossfeldt
items.note: 植物局部的放大特写，成为包豪斯与极简美学的意外灵感。
items.noteEn: Extreme close-ups of plant forms—an unlikely source of Bauhaus and minimalist aesthetics.

items.title: 二十世纪的人
items.creator: August Sander
items.note: 按职业分类的德国社会档案，被纳粹视为危险而禁售。
items.noteEn: A social archive of Germany classified by occupation—banned by the Nazis as dangerous.

items.title: 胡椒 No.30
items.creator: Edward Weston
items.note: 一颗青椒被拍出雕塑般的曲线，证明照片能抵达物的本质。
items.noteEn: A single pepper rendered as sculpture—proof that a photograph can reach a thing's essence.

items.title: 圣拉扎尔车站后
items.creator: Henri Cartier-Bresson
items.note: 跃过水洼的男子与身后海报女郎剪影几乎悬空呼应，被奉为抓拍的圣像。
items.noteEn: A man leaping over a puddle answers the dancer on the poster—canonised as the icon of the candid shot.

items.title: 纽约夜景
items.creator: Berenice Abbott
items.note: 在摩天楼拔地而起的年代记录曼哈顿夜色，「变化中的纽约」项目的代表影像。
items.noteEn: Manhattan at night during the skyscraper boom — a signature of her "Changing New York" project.

items.title: 琼·哈洛
items.creator: George Hurrell
items.note: 好莱坞黄金时代的光影把明星拍成神，一代影人的造像标准。
items.noteEn: Hollywood's golden-age lighting that shot stars as gods—the standard for a generation of glamour.

items.title: 巴黎之夜
items.creator: Brassaï
items.note: 深夜巴黎的雾、煤气灯与情侣，把夜生活拍成一座地下宫殿。
items.noteEn: Fog, gaslight and lovers in night Paris—the nocturnal city as an underground palace.

items.title: 夜巴黎
items.creator: Brassaï
items.note: 第一次系统拍摄雨夜巴黎的湿漉街巷与咖啡馆，确立了「夜间摄影」这一体裁。
items.noteEn: The first systematic night portrait of wet Paris streets and cafés — founding night photography as a genre.

items.title: 春树奇峰
items.creator: Lang Jingshan
items.note: 用多张底片在暗房合成的水墨山水，集锦摄影的开山之作。
items.noteEn: A darkroom composite of multiple negatives turned into ink-wash landscape—the origin of "composite photography".

items.title: 迁徙的母亲
items.creator: Dorothea Lange
items.note: 大萧条营地里的母亲，一根皱紧的眉成为整整一个时代的脸。
items.noteEn: A mother in a Depression camp—one furrowed brow became the face of an era.

items.title: 倒下的士兵
items.creator: Robert Capa
items.note: 西班牙内战里士兵中弹倒下的瞬间，战地摄影的传说（真实性常被质疑）。
items.noteEn: A soldier caught mid-fall in the Spanish Civil War—the legend of war photography, authenticity long debated.

items.title: 流水别墅
items.creator: Bill Hedrich (Hedrich-Blessing)
items.note: 赖特悬在瀑布上的名宅，1937年的经典影像让「有机建筑」理念成为全美焦点。
items.noteEn: The iconic 1937 view of Wright's house over the waterfall — the image that made organic architecture famous.

items.title: 伦敦之夜
items.creator: Bill Brandt
items.note: 战前伦敦的霓虹、睡在桥下的人与剧场后台，用强烈明暗写出城市的阶层剖面。
items.noteEn: Pre-war neon, sleepers under bridges, theater wings — stark chiaroscuro mapping London's class divide.

items.title: 美国照片
items.creator: Walker Evans
items.note: 大萧条时期美国城乡的冷静实录，确立纪实摄影的美学与伦理标高。
items.noteEn: A dispassionate record of Depression-era America — setting the aesthetic and ethical bar for documentary.

items.title: 纽约变迁
items.creator: Berenice Abbott
items.note: 在旧纽约被拆掉之前，用大画幅相机为它的街巷立传。
items.noteEn: Large-format portraits of old New York, made before demolition erased it.

items.title: 曼波彻束腰
items.creator: Horst P. Horst
items.note: 背对镜头的模特束腰曲线如古典雕塑，是《Vogue》黄金时代最著名的时尚影像之一。
items.noteEn: A model's back in a Mainbocher corset, sculptural as a Greek statue — one of Vogue's golden-age icons.

items.title: 月升，埃尔南德斯
items.creator: Ansel Adams
items.note: 在光线转瞬即逝里凭「预视」拍下的月升，是安塞尔·亚当斯区域曝光法的完美例证。
items.noteEn: A moonrise captured on instinct through "previsualization" — the perfect proof of Adams' zone system.

items.title: 温斯顿·丘吉尔
items.creator: Yousuf Karsh
items.note: 夺走雪茄换来的怒目而视，成了英国不愿屈服的象征。
items.noteEn: The snatched cigar earned a glare that became Britain's defiance.

items.title: 提顿山与蛇河
items.en: The Tetons and the Snake River
items.creator: Ansel Adams
items.note: 区域曝光法把山脉与河流压成层次分明的乐章，美国西部的圣像。
items.noteEn: The Zone System turns mountain and river into a clearly-articulated symphony—the American West's icon.

items.title: 清除冬季风暴
items.creator: Ansel Adams
items.note: 风暴初歇的约塞米蒂，云与花岗岩的剧烈对照。
items.noteEn: Yosemite as the storm lifts—a stark play of cloud against granite.

items.title: 赤裸城市
items.creator: Weegee
items.note: 闪光灯+夜班收音机扫街，把凶案、火灾与夜店写成纽约最赤裸的社会纪实。
items.noteEn: Flash and a police-band radio — crime, fire and nightlife as the rawest social record of New York.

items.title: 斯特拉文斯基
items.creator: Arnold Newman
items.note: 钢琴盖像帽子一样扣住作曲家，环境肖像的教科书。
items.noteEn: A piano lid framing the composer like a hat—the environmental portrait perfected.

items.title: 波因特洛沃斯
items.creator: Edward Weston
items.note: 岩石与海水的形态被拍成雕塑般的纹理，一生凝视同一片海岸。
items.noteEn: Rocks and surf reduced to sculptural form and texture—a lifetime at one coastline.

items.title: 乡间医生
items.creator: W. Eugene Smith
items.note: 与科罗拉多乡村医生同吃同住数周，把照片故事（photo essay）推到巅峰。
items.noteEn: Weeks living with a rural Colorado doctor—the photo essay pushed to its peak.

items.title: 达利的原子
items.creator: Philippe Halsman
items.note: 六小时、28次跳跃与泼水，才定格下达利与猫同时悬空的一瞬。
items.noteEn: Six hours, 28 jumps and flying water to freeze Dalí and the cats mid-air.

items.title: 在街上
items.creator: Helen Levitt
items.note: 哈莱姆儿童在街头游戏的黑白影像，把城市街头拍成孩子主宰的剧场。
items.noteEn: Children at play in Harlem's streets — the urban sidewalk as a theater ruled by kids.

items.title: 芝加哥
items.creator: Harry Callahan
items.note: 多重曝光与极简构图把芝加哥的日常抽成黑白几何，妻女是永远的主角。
items.noteEn: Multiple exposures and stark minimalism abstract Chicago's everyday—his wife and daughter the eternal subjects.

items.title: 纽约之夜
items.creator: Andreas Feininger
items.note: LIFE杂志的摩天楼夜景，长焦压缩把曼哈顿的天际线叠成一片光的墙。
items.noteEn: LIFE's telephoto night shots stacking Manhattan's skyline into a wall of light.

items.title: 市政厅之吻
items.en: Le Baiser de l'Hôtel de Ville
items.creator: Robert Doisneau
items.note: 巴黎街头拥吻的定格，多年后才承认是摆拍，却依旧是浪漫街拍的代名词。
items.noteEn: A kiss on a Paris street, later admitted staged—still the emblem of romantic street photography.

items.title: 鲁道夫·伯克哈特：纽约
items.creator: Rudolph Burckhardt
items.note: 毕生拍摄纽约街景的「城市诗人」，用轻快的构图见证都市的日常诗意。
items.noteEn: A lifelong chronicler of New York street life — light compositions catching the everyday poetry of the city.

items.title: 砂丘
items.creator: Shoji Ueda
items.note: 鸟取砂丘上家人摆成的超现实剪影，像一场被导演的白日梦。
items.noteEn: Family posed on Tottori's dunes as surreal silhouettes—a staged daydream.

items.title: 美人鱼礼服
items.creator: Irving Penn
items.note: 丽莎·冯萨格里斯身穿紧身鱼尾礼服，严谨构图与雕塑感剪影奠定工作室时尚摄影范式。
items.noteEn: Lisa Fonssagrives in a form-fitting evening gown — precise composition and sculpted silhouette define studio fashion.

items.title: 小商贩
items.creator: Irving Penn
items.note: 巴黎与伦敦的屠夫、面包师站在灰色背景前，每个职业都有尊严。
items.noteEn: Paris and London tradespeople posed against grey—the dignity of craft, one trade at a time.

items.title: 决定性瞬间
items.creator: Henri Cartier-Bresson
items.note: 布列松把「决定性瞬间」变成摄影的方法论：在流动的街头等几何与时机同时闭合的那一帧。
items.noteEn: Cartier-Bresson turned "the decisive moment" into a method: waiting for geometry and timing to close in one flowing frame.

items.title: 马赛公寓
items.creator: Lucien Hervé
items.note: 勒·柯布西耶的御用摄影师，用强烈黑白明暗与俯仰角度把混凝土粗野主义拍出雕塑般的节奏。
items.noteEn: Le Corbusier's house photographer, whose stark blacks and bold angles give raw concrete a sculptural rhythm.

items.title: 临近的阴影
items.creator: 何藩 Fan Ho
items.note: 香港旧楼间的光影几何，构图精练得像版画，是何藩最出圈的一张。
items.noteEn: Light and geometry between old Hong Kong tenements, composed like a woodcut—Fan Ho's best-known frame.

items.title: 工作室之窗
items.creator: Josef Sudek
items.note: 数十年凝视同一扇窗，光在玻璃与雾气上画水彩。
items.noteEn: Decades of the same window—light painting watercolours on glass and fog.

items.title: 朵维玛与大象
items.creator: Richard Avedon
items.note: 巴黎马戏团里黑衣模特在两头大象间的定格，被评为一世纪最重要的时尚照片之一。
items.noteEn: A black-gowned model frozen between circus elephants in Paris — voted one of the century's defining fashion images.

items.title: 玛丽莲·梦露
items.creator: Eve Arnold
items.note: 镁光灯下的倦怠，明星面孔背后藏着一层脆弱。
items.noteEn: Weariness under the lights—the fragility behind the star.

items.title: 人类的大家庭
items.creator: Edward Steichen
items.note: 273位摄影师、503张照片的史诗展览，冷战年代「人同此心」的最大证明。
items.noteEn: An epic exhibition of 503 prints by 273 photographers—a Cold War testament to shared humanity.

items.title: 薇薇安·迈尔街头摄影
items.creator: Vivian Maier
items.note: 保姆身份藏匿一生的街头杰作，遗物拍卖后被世界发现，成为业余摄影的传奇。
items.noteEn: A nanny's hidden lifetime of street genius, discovered at auction — the legend of the amateur rediscovered.

items.title: 纽约
items.creator: William Klein
items.note: 粗颗粒、广角变形与运动模糊，把街头摄影从优雅里一把拽出来。
items.noteEn: Grain, wide-angle distortion and blur yanked street photography out of its elegance.

items.title: 纽约（威廉·克莱因）
items.creator: William Klein
items.note: 广角、虚焦、冲撞式的街头快照，把纽约拍成喧闹的暴力拼贴。
items.noteEn: Wide-angle, blurry, colliding street snapshots — New York as a violent, noisy collage.

items.title: 白杨
items.creator: Ansel Adams
items.note: 逆光的白杨树皮近乎抽象，银盐质感被拉到极致。
items.noteEn: Backlit aspen trunks verging on abstraction—silver gelatin at its finest.

items.title: 美国人
items.creator: Robert Frank
items.note: 两万七千张底片炼成的「别样的美国」，彻底改写了街头与纪实的语法。
items.noteEn: A cross-country road vision that rewrote photography's grammar, making subjective documentary possible.

items.title: 巴西利亚
items.creator: Marcel Gautherot
items.note: 记录尼迈耶新首都拔地而起的曲线，混凝土被拍得轻盈如纸，巴西现代主义的视觉圣像。
items.noteEn: Niemeyer's new capital rising in concrete made to look paper-light — the visual icon of Brazilian modernism.

items.title: 凯斯研究住宅22号（斯塔尔住宅）
items.creator: Julius Shulman
items.note: 玻璃盒悬在洛杉矶夜空的经典一瞬，定义了现代主义住宅的「山顶神话」，20世纪被引用最多的建筑照片之一。
items.noteEn: The glass box floating over Los Angeles at night — the image that defined modernism's hilltop myth and one of the most reproduced architecture photos of the 20th century.

items.title: 月亮与半圆丘
items.creator: Ansel Adams
items.note: 满月悬在花岗岩穹顶之上，精准到像一次天文计算。
items.noteEn: A full moon poised over granite domes—precise as celestial calculation.

items.title: 裸体的透视
items.creator: Bill Brandt
items.note: 广角畸变把人体变成起伏的丘陵，超现实的黑白地貌。
items.noteEn: Wide-angle distortion turns the body into rolling hills—surreal monochrome terrain.

items.title: 拉瓦尔
items.creator: Joan Colom
items.note: 巴塞罗那红灯区的偷拍式街头快照，粗野直接，堪称西班牙街头摄影的孤峰。
items.noteEn: Sneaky, raw street flashes from Barcelona's red-light Raval — a lone peak of Spanish street photography.

items.title: 荒野蕴藏着世界的救赎
items.en: In Wildness Is the Preservation of the World
items.creator: Eliot Porter
items.note: 新英格兰森林的彩色特写与梭罗箴言并置，是最早把彩色用于严肃自然的书籍之一。
items.noteEn: Color close-ups of New England woods paired with Thoreau — among the first books to take color nature seriously.

items.title: TWA航站楼
items.creator: Ezra Stoller
items.note: 用中画幅把沙里宁的混凝土翼楼拍成白色鸟翼的流体雕塑，建筑摄影与建筑本身从此互相成就。
items.noteEn: Medium-format precision turns Saarinen's concrete wings into a fluid white bird — the shot that made architectural photography inseparable from architecture.

items.title: 斯卡诺
items.creator: Mario Giacomelli
items.note: 高反差把意大利山村的黑衣人剪成几何图形，近乎抽象表现主义。
items.noteEn: High contrast cuts black-clad figures in an Italian mountain village into geometry—near Abstract Expressionism.

items.title: 无人知晓之地
items.creator: Eliot Porter
items.note: 格伦峡谷被水库淹没前的彩色挽歌，一张照片也无法让水坝回头。
items.noteEn: A colour elegy for Glen Canyon before the dam drowned it—photography that could not turn the water back.

items.title: 月亮与墙
items.creator: Minor White
items.note: 把月亮、墙面与霜花拍成精神性的抽象，静观即修行。
items.noteEn: Moon, wall and frost as spiritual abstraction—looking as meditation.

items.title: 伸手
items.creator: Larry Burrows
items.note: 彩色战争摄影的先驱，越战中救护伤员的一组连贯叙事。
items.noteEn: A pioneer of colour war photography—one wounded soldier's arc through Vietnam.

items.title: 双胞胎
items.creator: Diane Arbus
items.note: 一模一样却气质迥异的两姐妹，凝视里长出了不安。
items.noteEn: Identical yet utterly different sisters—unease staring out of the frame.

items.title: 奔跑的白鹿
items.creator: Paul Caponigro
items.note: 白鹿在林中瞬间的凝滞，银盐里近乎灵视。
items.noteEn: A white deer held still in the trees—vision in silver.

items.title: 地出
items.creator: William Anders (Apollo 8)
items.note: 人类首次绕月时回望蓝白地球升起，被称作「人类历史上最具影响力的环境照片」。
items.noteEn: Earth rising over the lunar horizon on the first crewed Moon orbit — called the most influential environmental photo ever.

items.title: 挑衅（摄影杂志）
items.creator: 中平卓马·高梨丰·森山大道
items.note: 三期限定却影响深远的战后日本摄影杂志，「作为反叛的影像」运动的原点。
items.noteEn: A three-issue magazine that shook post-war Japanese photography — ground zero of "image as provocation."

items.title: 西贡枪决
items.creator: Eddie Adams
items.note: 枪口对准头部的千分之一秒，成为反战浪潮的催化剂。
items.noteEn: One split second of a pistol at a head—a catalyst of the anti-war movement.

items.title: 巴兹·奥尔德林踏上月面
items.creator: Neil Armstrong (Apollo 11)
items.note: 人类首次登月中阿姆斯特朗为同伴拍下的影像，头盔面罩映出月球荒原与登月舱。
items.noteEn: Armstrong's photo of Aldrin during the first Moon walk, the visor reflecting the lunar wasteland.

items.title: 动物
items.creator: Garry Winogrand
items.note: 动物园里人与动物面面相觑的荒诞瞬间，城市人目光的绝妙人类学。
items.noteEn: People and animals staring each other down at the zoo — brilliant anthropology of the urban gaze.

items.title: 伊斯坦布尔
items.creator: Ara Güler
items.note: 「伊斯坦布尔之眼」半个世纪的黑白街影，为一个正在消逝的城市留下灵魂。
items.noteEn: Half a century of black-and-white streets from the "Eye of Istanbul" — the soul of a vanishing city.

items.title: 自拍像
items.creator: Lee Friedlander
items.note: 影子、橱窗与反光里的自己，街头与自恋叠成一张复杂的底片。
items.noteEn: The self in shadows, shop windows and reflections—street-flavoured self-obsession on one complex negative.

items.title: 梦游者
items.creator: Ralph Gibson
items.note: 身体局部与光影的碎片，超现实的黑白拼图。
items.noteEn: Fragments of body and light—a surreal monochrome jigsaw.

items.title: 阅读中
items.creator: André Kertész
items.note: 全球街头读书人的侧影，安静而专注，构成一部世界阅读群像。
items.noteEn: Absorbed readers on streets around the world—a quiet, global portrait gallery of reading.

items.title: 感伤之旅
items.creator: Nobuyoshi Araki
items.note: 蜜月途中私拍妻子阳子，日本「私摄影」的起点。
items.noteEn: Intimate photos of his wife Yoko on their honeymoon—the origin of Japanese "private photography".

items.title: 流浪狗
items.creator: Daido Moriyama
items.note: 一只回头的流浪狗被他认作自己的自画像，成为都市疏离的图腾。
items.noteEn: A stray dog glancing back read as a self-portrait—an icon of urban alienation.

items.title: 破坏的生意
items.creator: Don McCullin
items.note: 战场上的崩溃瞬间，把战争的痛拍到骨头里。
items.noteEn: Moments of breakdown in war—conflict photographed to the bone.

items.title: 猎人
items.creator: Daido Moriyama
items.note: 粗颗粒、高反差、摇晃镜头下的日本城市，森山大道的「粗野美学」宣言。
items.noteEn: Grainy, high-contrast, jittery views of urban Japan — Moriyama's manifesto of the "are-bure-boke" aesthetic.

items.title: 卡夏尔广告
items.creator: Sarah Moon
items.note: 柔焦与流动的纱裙把广告拍成梦境，女性摄影师以「朦胧」对抗时装工业的硬朗。
items.noteEn: Soft focus and drifting chiffon turn an ad into a dream — a female gaze of haze against fashion's hardness.

items.title: 告别摄影
items.creator: Daido Moriyama
items.note: 过曝、失焦、粗颗粒的激进自否，森山大道式「粗糙、模糊、失焦」的宣言书。
items.noteEn: A radical self-negation of overexposure, blur and grain—the manifesto of Moriyama's "are, bure, boke".

items.title: 水俣
items.creator: W. Eugene Smith
items.note: 母亲为患水俣病的女儿沐浴的经典画面，他为此被厂方打伤也不放手。
items.noteEn: The famous bath scene of a mercury-poisoned girl—he was beaten for the photos and would not stop.

items.title: 蓝色弹珠
items.creator: NASA (Apollo 17 crew)
items.note: 阿波罗17号在距地4.5万公里拍下的完整地球，至今是「地球」最具标志性的形象。
items.noteEn: A fully lit Earth from Apollo 17 — still the most iconic portrait of our planet ever made.

items.title: 火从天降
items.creator: Nick Ut
items.note: 汽油弹中赤身奔逃的女孩，越战最痛的一张照片。
items.noteEn: A naked girl running from napalm—the most painful image of the Vietnam War.

items.title: 水塔
items.creator: Bernd & Hilla Becher
items.note: 同一正面视角拍遍欧洲工业水塔，「类型学」自此成为摄影方法，也是杜塞尔多夫学派的起点。
items.noteEn: Identical frontal views of industrial water towers across Europe founded the typology method and the Düsseldorf School.

items.title: 美国表象
items.creator: Stephen Shore
items.note: 公路旅行沿途的平凡桌面与街角，把彩色快照抬进美术馆。
items.noteEn: Ordinary tabletops and street corners along a road trip—snapshot aesthetics elevated to the museum.

items.title: 矿上
items.creator: David Goldblatt
items.note: 南非金矿工的黑与白，种族隔离制度下的劳动与尊严。
items.noteEn: Black and white of South Africa's gold miners—labour and dignity under apartheid.

items.title: 高原之光
items.creator: David Muench
items.note: 大画幅彩色拍科罗拉多高原，美国西部风景明信片美学的源头。
items.noteEn: Large-format colour of the Colorado Plateau—the source of the American West's postcard grandeur.

items.title: 新西部
items.creator: Robert Adams
items.note: 不动声色地拍科罗拉多被扩张吞噬的郊区，把「新地形学」变成现实。
items.noteEn: Unblinking frames of Colorado suburbs overtaken by sprawl—New Topographics made real.

items.title: 浴场
items.creator: Deborah Turbeville
items.note: 粗颗粒、虚焦、苍白的泳装故事，像被遗忘的旧照片，预言了时尚摄影的情绪转向。
items.noteEn: Grainy, soft-focus, faded swimwear story that looks like forgotten photographs — foretelling fashion's emotional turn.

items.title: 新地形学
items.creator: Robert Adams, Lewis Baltz et al.
items.note: 1975年罗切斯特的展览，用中性目光拍无人的郊区与工业带，终结了风景的浪漫。
items.noteEn: The 1975 Rochester show that looked at unpeopled suburbs and industrial strips with a deadpan eye, ending landscape's romance.

items.title: 女人是美丽的
items.creator: Garry Winogrand
items.note: 倾斜的取景框追逐纽约街头的女性，能量与失衡并存。
items.noteEn: Tilted frames chase women on New York streets—energy born of imbalance.

items.title: 查尔斯·乔丹广告
items.creator: Guy Bourdin
items.note: 高跟鞋广告拍成叙事悬疑的超现实静物，模糊商品与噩梦的界限，改写广告美学。
items.noteEn: Shoe ads staged as surreal narrative stills, blurring product and nightmare — a rewrite of advertising aesthetics.

items.title: 立体模型
items.creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
items.note: 拍博物馆的动物标本布景，以假乱真到开始失真。
items.noteEn: Museum dioramas photographed until the fake starts to feel real—and then not.

items.title: 格蕾丝·琼斯 · 加勒比女王
items.creator: Jean-Paul Goude
items.note: 把歌手塑造成黑白剪影、夸张身体的「图腾」，预演了后现代身份扮演的图像学。
items.noteEn: The singer carved into a black-and-white totem of exaggerated body — prescient iconography of postmodern identity play.

items.title: 狗（杂种）
items.creator: Elliott Erwitt
items.note: 蹲到狗的高度看世界，幽默全藏在巧合里，狗成了他的签名。
items.noteEn: Shooting at dog's-eye height, humour hiding in coincidence—dogs became his signature.

items.title: 公园
items.creator: Kohei Yoshiyuki
items.note: 红外闪光记录东京公园夜里的隐秘窥视，把「观看」本身拍成不安的证据。
items.noteEn: Infrared flash exposes covert encounters in a Tokyo park at night — looking captured as unease itself.

items.title: 约翰·列侬与小野洋子
items.creator: Annie Leibovitz
items.note: 滚石封面那张列侬蜷曲亲吻洋子的照片，拍后数小时他遇刺身亡。
items.noteEn: The Rolling Stone cover of Lennon curled against Ono—shot hours before his murder.

items.title: 地铁
items.creator: Bruce Davidson
items.note: 彩色闪光灯贴身记录纽约地铁众生相，把最拥挤的空间拍成最诚实的剧场。
items.noteEn: On-board flash portraits of the New York subway — the most crowded space as the most honest theater.

items.title: 剧场
items.creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
items.note: 一场电影的长曝光，让整个影厅亮成一块白色矩形。
items.noteEn: A feature-length exposure turns a movie screen into a single white rectangle.

items.title: 大裸体
items.creator: Helmut Newton
items.note: 超大尺幅、高跟鞋与权力的对峙，把时尚摄影推向挑衅与欲望的边界。
items.noteEn: Oversized, high-heeled and confrontational — fashion photography pushed to the edge of provocation and desire.

items.title: 尼加拉瓜
items.creator: Susan Meiselas
items.note: 革命与日常交织的中美洲，马格南镜头下的女性视角。
items.noteEn: Revolution and everyday life in Central America—a Magnum woman's view.

items.title: 在博克斯堡
items.creator: David Goldblatt
items.note: 南非白人小镇的日常细节，把种族隔离社会的「正常」拍得令人不安。
items.noteEn: Everyday detail of a white South African town — the "normal" of apartheid made unsettling.

items.title: 毛以后的中国
items.creator: Liu Heung Shing
items.note: 改革开放初期的日常面孔，普利策得主留下的第一手中国档案。
items.noteEn: Everyday faces of China's reform era—a Pulitzer-winning, first-hand archive.

items.title: 东京-横须贺
items.creator: Greg Girard
items.note: 70年代末驻日外景的霓虹夜街，在城市化前夜为日本留下一份彩色夜生活档案。
items.noteEn: Neon night streets of late-'70s Japan, shot before the boom — a color archive of a vanishing nightlife.

items.title: 阿富汗少女
items.creator: Steve McCurry
items.note: 绿眼睛难民少女登上《国家地理》封面，成了全世界最熟悉的难民之脸。
items.noteEn: The green-eyed refugee girl on National Geographic's cover—the world's most familiar face of exile.

items.title: 博帕尔惨案
items.creator: Raghu Rai
items.note: 毒气泄漏后的受害者，把工业灾难拍成印度的集体创伤。
items.noteEn: Victims of the gas leak—an industrial catastrophe rendered as India's collective wound.

items.title: 沙漠组歌
items.creator: Richard Misrach
items.note: 把美国西南沙漠当成一场持续数十年的摄影实验，荒芜里全是政治。
items.noteEn: The American Southwest desert as a decades-long photographic experiment—politics hiding in the emptiness.

items.title: 纳克塔
items.creator: Miguel Rio Branco
items.note: 巴西东北部的暴力色彩与贫困身体，把纪实推向视觉冲击的极限。
items.noteEn: Violent color and hard-lived bodies of Brazil's northeast — documentary pushed to visceral extremes.

items.title: 街头智慧
items.creator: Mary Ellen Mark
items.note: 西雅图街头的流浪少年，「小老鼠」的凝视久久不散。
items.noteEn: Runaway teens in Seattle—the gaze of "Tiny" lingers long after the page turns.

items.title: 美国西部
items.creator: Richard Avedon
items.note: 灰底影棚前直视镜头的矿工、牛仔，把肖像剥离成人的本质。
items.noteEn: Miners and cowboys staring into a grey studio backdrop—portraiture stripped to its essence.

items.title: 山之光
items.creator: Galen Rowell
items.note: 登山者的视角与「等待最佳光线」的哲学，让风光摄影成为一场与时间的赛跑。
items.noteEn: A climber's eye and a wait-for-the-light philosophy make landscape a race against time.

items.title: 塞拉佩拉达
items.creator: Sebastião Salgado
items.note: 五万淘金者挤在巨大矿坑里如蚁群般攀爬，劳动者的地狱图景。
items.noteEn: 50,000 gold miners swarming a vast open pit, climbing like an ant colony—a hellscape of labour.

items.title: 性依赖的叙事曲
items.creator: Nan Goldin
items.note: 快照式私影像记录波西米亚圈的爱与暴力，幻灯片放映成为仪式。
items.noteEn: Snapshot-style images of a bohemian circle—love and violence in a slide-show ritual.

items.title: 最后的度假地
items.creator: Martin Parr
items.note: 新布莱顿海滨的明艳庸常，用「俗艳」戳破英国的阶级与度假神话。
items.noteEn: The gaudy, ordinary seaside of New Brighton — garishness puncturing Britain's myths of class and holiday.

items.title: 无意识之地
items.creator: Thomas Struth
items.note: 正面平视的城市立面排比，把街道拍成心理档案，杜塞尔多夫学派冷静客观的典范。
items.noteEn: Flat, deadpan facade typologies turn streets into psychological archives — the cool objectivity of the Düsseldorf School.

items.title: 停火
items.creator: Michael Schmidt
items.note: 冷战后期的柏林市井与人像，严谨克制地记录分裂城市的日常生活。
items.noteEn: Everyday Berlin life and faces in the late Cold War — a rigorous record of a divided city.

items.title: 今日之获
items.creator: Thomas D. Mangelsen
items.note: 鲑鱼跃瀑直入棕熊之口的决定性瞬间，史上流传最广的野生动物照片之一。
items.noteEn: A spawning salmon leaping straight into a bear's jaws at Brooks Falls — one of the most circulated wildlife photos ever.

items.title: 海景
items.creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
items.note: 长曝光把海天各压成一半灰阶，时间在其中静止成永恒。
items.noteEn: Long exposures split sea and sky into equal halves—time suspended into eternity.

items.title: 胡奇坦
items.creator: Graciela Iturbide
items.note: 墨西哥萨波特克女性的日常与庆典，混血、幽默而庄重，拉美纪实摄影的杰作。
items.noteEn: The daily life and festivals of Zapotec women in Oaxaca — mixed, funny and solemn Latin American documentary.

items.title: 克劳迪娅·希弗的Guess广告
items.creator: Ellen von Unwerth
items.note: 把牛仔广告拍成即兴、俏皮、带欲望意味的「窥视」，模特本人成为镜头前最亮眼的主角。
items.noteEn: Jeans ads shot as playful, voyeuristic improvisation that made the model the star of her own film.

items.title: 住宅（类型学系列）
items.creator: Thomas Ruff
items.note: 德国平庸民居的正面照被放大到极致，让「无聊」本身成为值得凝视的主题。
items.noteEn: Blown-up frontal views of banal German homes, elevating boredom itself into a subject worth staring at.

items.title: 厨房餐桌系列
items.creator: Carrie Mae Weems
items.note: 自导自演的餐桌场景，把种族与性别叙事搬上家庭剧场。
items.noteEn: Self-directed scenes at a kitchen table—a domestic theatre of race and gender.

items.title: 寻找夏天
items.creator: Jim Brandenburg
items.note: 90天只拍90张照片的自我节制，让每一张都成为对大自然的郑重注视。
items.noteEn: Ninety days, just ninety exposures — restraint that turns every frame into a deliberate act of attention.

items.title: 我们被禁止的土地
items.creator: Fay Godwin
items.note: 在「禁止进入」的英国旷野上行走拍摄，把风景拍成了政治。
items.noteEn: Photographing Britain's fenced-off moors—landscape turned into politics.

items.title: 暗淡蓝点
items.creator: NASA / Voyager 1
items.note: 旅行者1号在64亿公里外回望地球仅为0.12像素，萨根借此写下著名的「暗淡蓝点」。
items.noteEn: From 4 billion miles out, Earth is a 0.12-pixel speck — the image behind Sagan's famous "Pale Blue Dot."

items.title: 超级名模
items.creator: Peter Lindbergh
items.note: 一月号群像把五位超模拍成素颜伙伴，九十年代时尚的开场白。
items.noteEn: The January cover shot of five supermodels barefaced—the opening statement of 1990s fashion.

items.title: 超级名模
items.creator: Peter Lindbergh
items.note: 不化妆的名模群像在海滩拍成黑白快照，终结了80年代浓妆风潮，开启「超模时代」。
items.noteEn: Unretouched, makeup-free supermodels on a beach — it ended the '80s gloss and opened the supermodel era.

items.title: 第三个爱之夏
items.creator: Corinne Day
items.note: 租屋里的凯特·摩丝穿着薄衫，以真实、粗颗粒、近乎纪实的语言打破华丽时尚。
items.noteEn: A teenage Kate Moss in a rented flat, shot raw and grainy — grunge realism that shattered glossy fashion.

items.title: 范思哲礼服，埃尔米拉日
items.creator: Herb Ritts
items.note: 沙漠里露背礼服与极简天空形成经典剪影，把时装拍成希腊雕塑般的身体颂歌。
items.noteEn: A backless gown against desert and sky — fashion turned into a Grecian sculptural ode to the body.

items.title: 默克尔岁月
items.creator: Herlinde Koelbl
items.note: 三十年间同一机位拍默克尔，权力与衰老一起写在脸上。
items.noteEn: Thirty years of Merkel in the same framing—power and ageing written on one face.

items.title: 贝鲁特
items.creator: Gabriele Basilico
items.note: 内战废墟上冷静的战后城市肖像，大画幅把创伤拍成克制而有尊严的测绘图。
items.noteEn: Dispassionate large-format portraits of a post-civil-war city, dignifying ruin with the discipline of a survey.

items.title: 黛米·摩尔
items.creator: Annie Leibovitz
items.note: 怀孕裸照登上《名利场》封面，引爆了身体与封面文化的争论。
items.noteEn: A nude pregnant Demi Moore on Vanity Fair—igniting debates on the body and magazine covers.

items.title: 大眼睛
items.creator: Xie Hailong
items.note: 那双「大眼睛」让无数人看见贫困儿童对读书的渴望，成为希望工程的象征。
items.noteEn: Those "big eyes" made a nation see a poor child's hunger to learn—the symbol of Project Hope.

items.title: 宇宙之景
items.creator: David Malin
items.note: 用化学方法合成三色影像，把南半球星云的色彩与纤维细节首次带进大众视野。
items.noteEn: Three-color photographic synthesis that first brought the color and filament detail of southern nebulae to the public.

items.title: 影之城
items.creator: Alexey Titarenko
items.note: 圣彼得堡的长曝光把人流拖成幽灵般的灰影，街头变成时间的河床。
items.noteEn: Long exposures in St. Petersburg drag crowds into ghostly grey streaks—the street as a riverbed of time.

items.title: 麦当娜《Sex》
items.creator: Steven Meisel
items.note: 把流行天后铸成挑衅与审美试验的载体，1992年文化事件级时尚写真集。
items.noteEn: The pop queen remade as provocation and aesthetic experiment — a culture-event fashion book of 1992.

items.title: 黑暗之城
items.creator: Greg Girard & Ian Lambot
items.note: 深入九龙城寨的日光与夜景纪实，为已消失的「无主之城」留下最完整的影像。
items.noteEn: Daylight and night records of Kowloon Walled City — the most complete visual archive of the lost enclave.

items.title: 秃鹫与小女孩
items.en: The Vulture and the Little Girl
items.creator: Kevin Carter
items.note: 饥荒中蹲踞的秃鹫与垂死孩童，获奖后却引来巨大的争议与自责。
items.noteEn: A vulture waiting beside a starving child—a Pulitzer followed by public outcry and guilt.

items.title: 劳动者
items.creator: Sebastião Salgado
items.note: 煤矿、油田与手工作坊里被汗水和体力定义的肉身，劳动的纪念碑。
items.noteEn: Mines, oil fields and workshops—bodies defined by sweat and muscle, a monument to labour.

items.title: 海滩肖像
items.creator: Rineke Dijkstra
items.note: 青春期少年少女站在海边，姿态与不安暴露无遗。
items.noteEn: Adolescents at the shore—posture and unease laid bare against the sea.

items.title: 凯特·摩丝 · CK Obsession
items.creator: Mario Sorrenti
items.note: 卧室里黑白近摄的摩丝写真，把「真实」包装成90年代最有力的香水广告。
items.noteEn: Intimate black-and-white close-ups of Moss in bed — authenticity packaged as the decade's most powerful perfume ad.

items.title: 地面
items.creator: Uta Barth
items.note: 模糊的室内光线与角落，让人重新看见「看」本身。
items.noteEn: Blurred light and corners—making us see seeing itself.

items.title: 创生之柱
items.creator: NASA / ESA (Hubble)
items.note: 哈勃拍摄鹰状星云的恒星育婴室，成为天文摄影史上被转载最多的照片之一。
items.noteEn: Hubble's view of star nurseries in the Eagle Nebula — one of the most reproduced images in astronomical history.

items.title: 海地
items.creator: Bruce Gilden
items.note: 直怼人脸的闪光灯人像，粗暴却充满生命力，把街头逼近到冒犯。
items.noteEn: In-your-face flash portraits, brutal yet brimming with life—street photography pushed into provocation.

items.title: 苏格兰之光与土地
items.en: Scotland: The Light and the Land
items.creator: Colin Prior
items.note: 大画幅相机把苏格兰高地拍得壮阔而纯净，像地球的骨架。
items.noteEn: Large-format clarity across the Scottish Highlands—the planet's bare bones.

items.title: 我们这一代
items.creator: Xiao Quan
items.note: 记录崔健、张艺谋等一代文化名人，一个时代的精神群像。
items.noteEn: Portraits of Cui Jian, Zhang Yimou and a generation—the psyche of an era in one book.

items.title: 与夜相识
items.creator: Lynn Saville
items.note: 黄昏与黎明之交的城市空镜，把纽约拍成介于昼与夜之间的静谧地带。
items.noteEn: Cities at the border of dusk and dawn — New York as a quiet zone between day and night.

items.title: 海尔-波普彗星 · 纪念碑谷
items.creator: Wally Pacholka
items.note: 双尾彗星悬在红色砂岩孤峰之上，成为上世纪90年代末最著名的天文照片之一。
items.noteEn: The twin-tailed comet above red rock spires — one of the most famous astronomical images of the late '90s.

items.title: 凝视
items.creator: Frans Lanting
items.note: 低角度把野生动物拍成与人类平视的个体，黑白影棚式肖像赋予它们尊严与性格。
items.noteEn: Studio-like, low-angle portraits that meet wild animals as equals, giving them dignity and character.

items.title: 长时间曝光
items.creator: Michael Wesely
items.note: 快门开了三年，把施工中的柏林拍成时间的残影。
items.noteEn: Shutters open for years turn a Berlin construction site into a trace of time.

items.title: 虎之年
items.creator: Michael Nichols
items.note: 与印度科学家用自动相机拍到野生孟加拉虎，为大型猫科动物建立了可亲近的影像。
items.noteEn: Remote cameras in India capturing wild Bengal tigers — making the big cats approachable on the page.

items.title: 麦客
items.creator: Hou Dengke
items.note: 关中麦客候鸟般迁徙割麦，黄土高原上一个人的史诗。
items.noteEn: Migrant wheat-cutters crossing the Guanzhong plain—one man's epic of the loess plateau.

items.title: 99美分
items.creator: Andreas Gursky
items.note: 超市货架的万花筒式俯视，把消费主义景观拍成无限重复的数字矩阵。
items.noteEn: A kaleidoscopic supermarket interior — consumerist spectacle as an endlessly repeated digital matrix.

items.title: 病历
items.creator: Boris Mikhailov
items.note: 乌克兰后苏联街头的流民，用身体表演自己的绝望。
items.noteEn: The homeless of post-Soviet Kharkiv, performing their own despair.

items.title: 试镜
items.creator: Juergen Teller
items.note: 用傻瓜相机拍模特们的「海选」照，不修片、不摆pose，把时尚拉回素人状态。
items.noteEn: Point-and-shoot casting photos, unretouched and unposed — fashion dragged back to the amateur present.

items.title: 地狱
items.creator: James Nachtwey
items.note: 九年间九场冲突的集结，战地摄影沉重的史诗。
items.noteEn: Nine conflicts across nine years—a grave epic of photojournalism.

items.title: 情歌（我的自尽）
items.creator: Rut Blees Luxemburg
items.note: 伦敦街头的长曝光把霓虹与雨水拍成抒情诗，让「城市之夜」有了哲学化的暧昧。
items.noteEn: Long exposures turn London's neon and rain into lyric — the urban night given philosophical ambivalence.

items.title: 莱茵河2号
items.creator: Andreas Gursky
items.note: 数字抹除厂房后的极简莱茵河，2011年以430万美元成交，曾是全球最贵照片。
items.noteEn: A digitally purified Rhine, stripped of factories into minimal horizontals — sold for $4.3M in 2011, then the most expensive photo ever.

items.title: 色彩之河
items.creator: Raghubir Singh
items.note: 在西方纪实仍偏爱黑白时，用徕卡拍出印度街头的饱和色彩，开创彩色街头传统。
items.noteEn: Saturated Leica color of Indian streets while Western documentary favored black-and-white — founder of a color street tradition.

items.title: 人行道
items.creator: Jeff Mermelstein
items.note: 纽约人行道上电话与私语的瞬间，像在城市里偷听。
items.noteEn: Moments of phones and whispers on New York sidewalks—eavesdropping on the city.

items.title: 水、光、时间
items.creator: David Doubilet
items.note: 国家地理水摄泰斗的精选，证明海面之下同样有着剧场般的秩序与颜色。
items.noteEn: Nat Geo's master of underwater photography shows the sea holds its own theater of order and color.

items.title: SHOWstudio
items.creator: Nick Knight
items.note: 首个把时尚影像直播化、实验化的平台，让摄影与动态影像、科技持续交锋。
items.noteEn: The first platform to broadcast and experiment with fashion imagery live — where photography meets film and tech.

items.title: 野性生灵
items.creator: Art Wolfe
items.note: 用绝佳构图把动物的姿态与背景图案化，证明野生动物摄影也可以是形式艺术。
items.noteEn: Animals' postures composed into graphic patterns — wildlife photography as formal art.

items.title: 门诺派
items.creator: Larry Towell
items.note: 与门诺派同住多年，马格南为封闭社群留下一部影像档案。
items.noteEn: Years living among the Mennonites—a Magnum archive of a closed community.

items.title: 空中看美国
items.creator: Yann Arthus-Bertrand
items.note: 直升机低空航拍把美国的几何田野与城市肌理变成抽象图案，全球最畅销航拍书「从空中看地球」的美洲卷。
items.noteEn: Low-altitude aerial views turn American farmland and city grids into abstract geometry — the America volume of the world's best-selling "Earth from the Air."

items.title: 火车上的中国人
items.creator: Wang Fuchun
items.note: 绿皮车里三十年的人生百态，流动中国的横向切片。
items.noteEn: Thirty years of life inside China's hard-seat carriages—a cross-section of a nation in motion.

items.title: 逐屋
items.creator: Todd Hido
items.note: 透过车窗外拍的美国郊区住宅，在幽蓝夜色里暧昧不安，重新定义了夜间快照。
items.noteEn: Suburban homes shot through a car window in uneasy blue dark — redefining the nocturnal snapshot.

items.title: 熔点
items.creator: Stéphane Couturier
items.note: 汽车工厂内部被拆解重组成马赛克般的几何抽象，工业建筑转化为像素化图像。
items.noteEn: Car-factory interiors dissected into mosaic-like abstraction, industrial architecture turned pixelated image.

items.title: 俺爹俺娘
items.creator: Jiao Bo
items.note: 三十年拍父母在乡下的日常，中国乡村亲情最绵长的注脚。
items.noteEn: Thirty years of a peasant couple's daily life—the longest footnote to Chinese family love.

items.title: 中空
items.creator: Masao Yamamoto
items.note: 小尺寸照片像一页页俳句，留白本身就是禅。
items.noteEn: Small prints like pages of haiku—emptiness as the point.

items.title: 假寐
items.creator: Rinko Kawauchi
items.note: 日常里瞬间的光，轻柔得几乎无声，却让时间慢下来。
items.noteEn: Fleeting light in the everyday, soft almost to silence—yet it slows time.

items.title: 建筑（模糊系列）
items.creator: Hiroshi Sugimoto
items.note: 故意失焦把地标建筑还原成记忆中的模糊剪影，让建筑照片变成关于「看见」本身的冥想。
items.noteEn: Deliberate defocus reduces landmarks to blurred memory-traces — architecture as a meditation on seeing itself.

items.title: 密度建筑
items.creator: Michael Wolf
items.note: 正面压缩香港公屋外立面的重复窗格，把高密度居住拍成令人窒息的秩序图案。
items.noteEn: Front-on compression of Hong Kong housing facades turns density into a suffocating grid of repetition.

items.title: 艾拉
items.creator: Rinko Kawauchi
items.note: 用轻薄色彩捕捉空气里的浮尘与呼吸，日常如偈语。
items.noteEn: Dust and breath caught in gossamer colour—the everyday as a Zen phrase.

items.title: 哈勃超深场
items.creator: NASA / ESA (Hubble)
items.note: 对准天球极小一块累积曝光百万秒，数出约一万个星系——可见宇宙的「深场」剖面。
items.noteEn: A million-second exposure of a tiny patch of sky revealing ~10,000 galaxies — a core sample of the visible universe.

items.title: 午夜前
items.creator: Trent Parke
items.note: 澳洲盛夏黄昏的奇异光线与城市幽灵，把「家国」拍成末日将至的寓言。
items.noteEn: A 90,000 km road trip across Australia in brooding black and white—the nation rendered dark and incandescent.

items.title: 都柏林圣三一学院图书馆
items.creator: Candida Höfer
items.note: 无人空间的宏大堂内景观，对称、静谧、色彩精准，让公共建筑的秩序之美自己说话。
items.noteEn: Vast, people-free interiors of public institutions — symmetry, silence and exact color let order speak for itself.

items.title: 视觉
items.creator: 陈漫 Chen Man
items.note: 数码后期与东方视觉符号混融的时装大片，开创中国时尚摄影的「视觉系」语言。
items.noteEn: Digital retouching fused with Eastern visual symbols — the "visionary" language that opened Chinese fashion photography.

items.title: 天域黄山
items.creator: Wang Wusheng
items.note: 以水墨笔意拍黄山云海，把东方山水翻译成银盐黑白。
items.noteEn: Huangshan clouds shot with ink-wash intent—Eastern landscape redeveloped in silver.

items.title: 特写
items.creator: Martin Schoeller
items.note: 明星与普通人的「大头照」，同一盏灯抹平了所有等级。
items.noteEn: Celebrities and strangers as "big heads"—one light erases all hierarchy.

items.title: 人造风景
items.creator: Edward Burtynsky
items.note: 采石场、煤矿与集装箱港口的巨幅俯视，让工业破坏呈现出近乎美的震撼尺度。
items.noteEn: Huge views of quarries, mines and ports make industrial destruction almost beautiful in scale.

items.title: 洪水之后
items.creator: Robert Polidori
items.note: 飓风卡特里娜后新奥尔良民居的霉菌墙面，大画幅把灾难痕迹拍成静物般庄严的遗存。
items.noteEn: Katrina-ravaged New Orleans interiors, the moldy walls shot large-format into solemn still lifes of loss.

items.title: 9·11 之后
items.creator: Joel Meyerowitz
items.note: 获准进入世贸遗址的摄影师，记录下整整一年的清理与重生。
items.noteEn: Granted rare access to Ground Zero, he documented a full year of recovery and rebirth.

items.title: 早期彩色
items.creator: Saul Leiter
items.note: 1950年代纽约彩色街头被尘封半世纪后才出版，色块与倒影的绘画感改写街头摄影。
items.noteEn: 1950s New York color unseen for half a century — color fields and reflections that redefined street photography.

items.title: 北海道
items.creator: Michael Kenna
items.note: 雪原上的孤树与冰面，极简到只剩下呼吸，长曝光把雪抹成缎子。
items.noteEn: Lone trees and ice fields in snow, reduced to breath—long exposure turns snow to silk.

items.title: 我，东京
items.creator: Jacob Aue Sobol
items.note: 深夜东京地铁与街头的高感光黑白，把陌生都市拍成心跳般的亲密存在。
items.noteEn: High-ISO black-and-white of late-night Tokyo transit and streets — the alien city felt as a heartbeat.

items.title: 我的窗外
items.creator: Gail Albert Halaban
items.note: 长焦隔着窗户拍摄都市邻居的生活片段，把窥视变成带有距离的温柔。
items.noteEn: Telephoto glimpses of neighbors through windows — voyeurism made tender by distance.

items.title: 静谧之光
items.creator: John Sexton
items.note: 继承亚当斯的区域曝光法，专拍清晨的雾与微光。
items.noteEn: The Zone System's heir, photographing dawn light and fog.

items.title: 迪士尼梦境肖像
items.creator: Annie Leibovitz
items.note: 把明星扮进童话名场面，高预算时装叙事与流行文化的交汇之作。
items.noteEn: Stars staged into fairy-tale tableaux — where high-budget fashion storytelling meets pop culture.

items.title: 战火中的大猩猩
items.creator: Brent Stirton
items.note: 刚果战乱中被杀害的山地大猩猩被士兵抬出，获2008年荷赛年度照片。
items.noteEn: Dead mountain gorillas carried from Congo's conflict — World Press Photo of the Year 2008.

items.title: 失落的前卫
items.creator: Richard Pare
items.note: 逐栋记录苏联构成主义建筑的危楼遗存，很多建筑在他拍摄后即被拆除，成为救赎性的档案。
items.noteEn: A survey of surviving Soviet Constructivist buildings, many demolished right after he shot them — a redemptive archive.

items.title: 开车看美国
items.creator: Lee Friedlander
items.note: 挡风玻璃内外叠影的美国公路，把「汽车社会」拍成不断叠加的视觉白噪音。
items.noteEn: Windshield-framed America, foreground and street stacked — car culture as layered visual noise.

items.title: 弗拉姆博亚
items.creator: Viviane Sassen
items.note: 非洲炽烈阳光下几何化的身体与影子，让时尚摄影有了观念艺术的锐度。
items.noteEn: Bodies and shadows reduced to geometry in harsh African sun — fashion with the edge of conceptual art.

items.title: 广岛
items.creator: Ishiuchi Miyako
items.note: 遇难者的衣服、眼镜与鞋的特写，记忆被缝进织物里。
items.noteEn: Close-ups of victims' garments, glasses and shoes—memory stitched into fabric.

items.title: 雪豹
items.creator: Steve Winter
items.note: 用遥控相机在喜马拉雅夜间拍到野生雪豹正面照，完成了一次堪称奇迹的拍摄工程。
items.noteEn: A remote-camera night shot of a wild snow leopard in the Himalayas — a near-impossible photographic feat.

items.title: 被人遗忘的人
items.creator: Lü Nan
items.note: 1989-90年走访38家精神病院，用三年时间把尊严还给被遗忘者。
items.noteEn: Three years inside 38 psychiatric hospitals (1989-90) that gave dignity back to the forgotten.

items.title: 街头自拍
items.creator: Vivian Maier
items.note: 保姆身份拍下逾十万张底片，死后才被发掘，影子里反复出现的自拍最迷人。
items.noteEn: A nanny left over 100,000 negatives found posthumously—her shadow self-portraits are the most haunting.

items.title: 夜色中的世界
items.creator: Tunc Tezel
items.note: TWAN「夜空世界」网络的核心成员，让星空与地景的摄影成为跨文化协作。
items.noteEn: A core member of TWAN's night-sky network — sky-and-landscape photography as cross-cultural collaboration.

items.title: 异教徒
items.creator: Tim Hetherington
items.note: 与美军同驻阿富汗山谷，镜头贴近到能听见呼吸。
items.noteEn: Embedded with US troops in Afghanistan's valley—close enough to hear them breathe.

items.title: 罗马MAXXI美术馆
items.creator: Hélène Binet
items.note: 只用胶片和自然光拍扎哈的流动混凝土曲面，把建筑细部抽象成光与影的素描。
items.noteEn: Film and natural light alone render Zaha's flowing concrete as a drawing in light and shadow.

items.title: 在这片土地上，阴影降临
items.en: On This Earth, A Shadow Falls
items.creator: Nick Brandt
items.note: 东非动物站在人类改造的风景里如肖像般凝视，把生态哀歌拍成庄严肃穆的黑白剧。
items.noteEn: East African animals posed like human portraits amid altered land — an ecological elegy as solemn black-and-white drama.

items.title: 深空之色
items.creator: Rogelio Bernal Andreo
items.note: 用窄带滤镜把猎户座一带拍出斑斓气体细节，业余天文摄影技艺的巅峰示范。
items.noteEn: Narrowband filters turn the Orion region into swirls of gas and color — amateur astrophotography at its peak.

items.title: 光明
items.creator: Rinko Kawauchi
items.note: 以柔焦与低饱和看城市夜光、雪花与萤火，把日常之光拍成恍惚的微光诗。
items.noteEn: Soft, pale views of city lights, snow and fireflies — everyday luminance as a dreamy poem of light.

items.title: 海洋之魂
items.creator: Brian Skerry
items.note: 二十年潜入全球海域的鲸豚档案，把海洋生物拍成需要被保护的「人物」。
items.noteEn: Two decades of whale and dolphin imagery — ocean life portrayed as characters worthy of protection.

items.title: 野放熊猫
items.creator: Ami Vitale
items.note: 记录人工繁育大熊猫走向野外的瞬间，保育议题从此有了温柔而有力的影像面孔。
items.noteEn: Captive-bred pandas stepping into the wild — conservation given a tender, powerful visual face.

items.title: 极地执念
items.creator: Paul Nicklen
items.note: 极地摄影师的毕生档案，把冰下世界与北极熊拍成冷冽而亲密的存在。
items.noteEn: A lifetime of polar archives, rendering the under-ice world and polar bears cold and intimate.

items.title: 塞伦盖蒂间谍
items.creator: Anup Shah
items.note: 用遥控相机把镜头贴进狮群，让草原之王卸下防备，露出近乎家庭化的日常。
items.noteEn: Remote cameras placed inside the pride make the kings of the savanna drop their guard into near-family scenes.

items.title: 洪水（拉沙佩勒）
items.creator: David LaChapelle
items.note: 奢华与末日在艳俗色彩里同框，让时尚摄影成为批判消费主义的寓言。
items.noteEn: Luxury and apocalypse share one garish frame — fashion photography as a fable against consumerism.

items.title: 光的苦痛
items.creator: Alex Webb
items.note: 加勒比与墨西哥的浓烈色彩，复杂构图层层嵌套，每帧都像解谜。
items.noteEn: Three decades of intricate color street across continents — color stretched between density and solitude.

items.title: 极乐鸟
items.creator: Tim Laman & Ed Scholes
items.note: 走遍新几内亚为所有极乐鸟物种建立影像档案，堪称鸟类摄影的「物种大全」。
items.noteEn: Crossing New Guinea to archive every bird-of-paradise species — an almost complete inventory of one bird family.

items.title: 不止于人类
items.creator: Tim Flach
items.note: 影棚里的动物肖像被拍成拟人化的「他者」，审视人类与动物间的镜像关系。
items.noteEn: Studio portraits that anthropomorphize animals into "others" — a mirror held between species.

items.title: 说书人
items.creator: Tim Walker
items.note: 手工置景的童话奇观，超大裙摆与超现实道具在胶片里复活维多利亚式幻想。
items.noteEn: Hand-built fairytale tableaux where oversized gowns and surreal props revive Victorian fantasy on film.

items.title: 大卫塔
items.creator: Iwan Baan
items.note: 委内瑞拉未完工摩天楼被数千居民自建改造的垂直社区，让「建筑」从设计走向真实生活。
items.noteEn: An unfinished Caracas skyscraper turned self-built vertical village — architecture as lived reality, not render.

items.title: 维纳斯的诞生
items.creator: Mark Gee
items.note: 跳入星海的人影剪影，获2013年「年度天文摄影师」总冠军。
items.noteEn: A silhouette leaping into the Milky Way — overall winner of the 2013 Astronomy Photographer of the Year.

items.title: 创世纪
items.creator: Sebastião Salgado
items.note: 八年奔走全球寻找未经文明触碰之地，用大画幅黑白为地球留下「创世记」档案。
items.noteEn: Eight years seeking the planet's pristine places — a large-format black-and-white Genesis archive of Earth.

items.title: 留尼汪火山星空
items.creator: Luc Perrot
items.note: 熔岩红与银河银在同一画面里对峙，火山口成为星空摄影最戏剧性的前景。
items.noteEn: Molten glow and the galactic core in one frame — an erupting crater as the most dramatic of foregrounds.

items.title: 北极光
items.creator: Ole Salomonsen
items.note: 挪威摄影师在极夜小镇持续数年的极光延时与静帧，把舞动的光拍成天体剧场。
items.noteEn: Years of aurora time-lapses and stills from a Norwegian polar town — dancing light as celestial theater.

items.title: 世上最古老的生灵
items.en: The Oldest Living Things in the World
items.creator: Rachel Sussman
items.note: 为树龄数千年的个体生命建档，用摄影丈量时间尺度，也让「活体」有了肖像。
items.noteEn: Archiving organisms thousands of years old — photography measuring deep time, giving ancient life a portrait.

items.title: 想一想英格兰
items.creator: Matt Stuart
items.note: 伦敦街头的巧合错位，幽默藏在三次快门之间。
items.noteEn: Coincidental collisions on London streets—humour hiding between three quick frames.

items.title: 格林童话景观
items.creator: Kilian Schönberger
items.note: 色盲摄影师拍出的雾林夜色，恰好呼应德国童话里神秘的森林氛围。
items.noteEn: A color-blind photographer's misty forest nights — perfectly matching the eerie woods of German fairy tales.

items.title: 全谱优势
items.creator: Simon Norfolk
items.note: 德国美军基地被拍成迷彩般的彩绘城，把「军事建筑即景观」这一逻辑推到极致。
items.noteEn: US bases in Germany become camouflage-painted cityscapes — military architecture as landscape, pushed to its end.

items.title: 内罗毕城市
items.creator: Mutua Matheka
items.note: 以现代建筑与滑板青年重塑非洲首都的视觉形象，突破西方视角的单一想象。
items.noteEn: Modern towers and skateboarders reframing an African capital — pushing past the single Western image of Africa.

items.title: 腔棘鱼
items.creator: Laurent Ballesta
items.note: 潜水记录活体腔棘鱼这一「活化石」，填补了人类对该物种影像的百年空白。
items.noteEn: Diving to film a living coelacanth — a "living fossil" unseen alive by humans for a century.

items.title: 长城上的银河
items.en: The Milky Way above the Great Wall
items.creator: 戴建峰 Jeff Dai
items.note: 让长城与银河同框，带动了中文互联网天文摄影的爆发式普及。
items.noteEn: The Great Wall under a Milky Way arch — a catalyst for the explosion of Chinese astrophotography online.

items.title: 瑞典极光
items.creator: Göran Strand
items.note: 用全景接片把极光拱门与雪原树影收入画面，极光摄影中「环境」意识的代表。
items.noteEn: A full-arch aurora over snow and pines — emblematic of the environmental turn in aurora photography.

items.title: 北极熊群像
items.creator: Roie Galitz
items.note: 无人机视角的北极熊群聚影像走红全球，也让气候议题以可爱又忧伤的方式被看见。
items.noteEn: A drone-view crowd of polar bears that went viral — climate grief delivered with charm.

items.title: 金丝猴
items.creator: Marsel van Oosten
items.note: 中国滇金丝猴与环境融为一体的构图，斩获索尼世界摄影奖野生动物类大奖。
items.noteEn: A Yunnan snub-nosed monkey fused into its landscape — winner of Sony World Photography's wildlife prize.

items.title: 东京夜色
items.creator: Masashi Wakui
items.note: 社交媒体时代崛起的霓虹街拍，把东京后街拍成宫崎骏动画里的静谧夜景。
items.noteEn: Neon backstreet shots that swept social media — Tokyo as a hushed Ghibli night.

items.title: 空间站凌日
items.creator: Thierry Legault
items.note: 在精确计算的瞬间拍到空间站掠过日面的剪影，把「巧合」变成一门精密的科学。
items.noteEn: Calculating the exact second the ISS crosses the solar disk — serendipity turned into exact science.

items.title: 现代色彩
items.creator: Fred Herzog
items.note: 1950年代就用柯达克罗姆拍温哥华街头，比彩色摄影主流早了二十年。
items.noteEn: Kodachrome street scenes of 1950s Vancouver, decades ahead of the mainstream colour movement.

items.title: 影像方舟
items.creator: Joel Sartore
items.note: 为全球物种建立黑白棚拍肖像库，用「方舟」隐喻回应第六次大灭绝。
items.noteEn: Studio portraits of Earth's species against black and white — an ark against the sixth extinction.

items.title: 碧昂丝 · Vogue封面
items.creator: Tyler Mitchell
items.note: 26岁成为Vogue创刊126年来首位拍摄封面的黑人摄影师，用田园阳光改写时尚权力地图。
items.noteEn: At 26, the first Black photographer to shoot a Vogue cover in its 126-year history — sunlit, pastoral, redefining fashion's power map.

items.title: 西部之光
items.creator: Paul Zizka
items.note: 落基山脉的星空、极光与冰川之夜，让夜间风光摄影抵达可攀可近的现场感。
items.noteEn: Star-filled nights over the Canadian Rockies — night landscape made physically reachable and present.

items.title: 夜空景观
items.creator: Michael Shainblum
items.note: 把美国西部的银河接片与前景合成，代表了现代「夜空风景」的视觉美学。
items.noteEn: Milky Way panoramas fused with western US foregrounds — the look of the contemporary night-landscape wave.

items.title: M87黑洞
items.creator: Event Horizon Telescope
items.note: 事件视界望远镜用全球射电阵列首次给黑洞拍照，橙红光环成为科学的全民符号。
items.noteEn: The first image of a black hole's shadow, built from a planet-wide radio array — science's viral orange ring.

items.title: 雪豹 · 青藏
items.creator: Vincent Munier
items.note: 在青藏高原风雪中用长焦守候雪豹，把濒危猛兽拍成天地间一抹极简的灰影。
items.noteEn: Long-lens vigils in the Tibetan highlands render the endangered cat a wisp of gray in a vast white world.

items.title: 东京夜游
items.creator: Liam Wong
items.note: 游戏美术师出身，用赛博朋克配色把雨夜东京拍成电子游戏般的场景。
items.noteEn: A game designer's cyberpunk palette turns rainy Tokyo into a playable-looking cityscape.

items.title: 韦布首张深场
items.creator: NASA / ESA / CSA (JWST)
items.note: 韦布望远镜以红外之眼深挖130亿年前的星系团，宣告下一代深空时代的开启。
items.noteEn: The Webb telescope's infrared gaze into a 13-billion-year-old cluster, opening the next era of deep space.
